description: This is a SQL migration script that creates and manages the 'work_item' table, which stores tasks and bugs associated with projects in a database. It includes table creation, triggers for auto-incrementing IDs per project, policies for row-level security, and cleanup routines for development re-runs.

methods.name: public.fn_work_item_assign_incremental_id
methods.description: A trigger function that assigns the next incremental ID within a project when a new work item is inserted.

calls: select coalesce(max(w.id), 0) + 1 from public.work_item w where w.project_id = NEW.project_id
select p.project_key from public.projects p where p.id = project_id
